description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Requires experience with Java, Servlet, J2EE and an understanding of linking to back-end applications.
 Requires strong interaction and communication with business line.
 Analyzes, designs, implements, and supports web-related applications support of company’s internet/intranet strategy. Strong understanding of O-O.
 Skills: Java, Spring, J2EE, JSP, Servlet, DB2, SQL, JUnit
 Vantage Point Project Info from Hiring Manager: 
 Traditionally, companies have paid for products and services using printed invoices and checks. This made the receivers of those payments (aka receivables) happy, since they could use a single process to reconcile the payment back to the remittance advice and the original invoice. As electronics payments have proliferated, the standardization in the way companies can process those payments and remittance has eroded. Payments often arrive through different channels from non-matching, incomplete, or missing remittance information.
 VantagePoint attempts to standardize receivables processing regardless of payment type: 
 Enable customers to specify key remittance fields required to automatically post incoming payments 
 All payments will be processed through defined filters/rules
 Payer Lookup to enhance remitter identification
 Visibility to all incoming payments at summary and detail level through a web user interface
 Workflow capabilities to research, correct and route exception payments (i.e. payments that do not contain all required remittance fields)
 Transmit consolidated payment / image files in specified format  
 Generate customized receivables reporting
 To accomplish this, we are developing this product internally using an agile development approach. Technical skills will involve Java, J2EE, Spring, Struts, JSP, SQL, ClearCase, and JavaScript technologies, working in an agile team with other full-time and contract resources. Resources are expected to be able to to quickly understand and work in large, existing projects, and to enhance and change that project. Team members will work in an agile model, which means they will collaborate with their Product Owner to understand business needs, and then be able to create and update the code accordingly. Team members are responsible for working the system from front-to-back, JSP to Database, and be able to create and diagnose each layer of the application . 
 Although the technologies are common, this is not a straightforward or easy project. Bringing these payment types together, and implementing the workflow and reconciliation tasks, are difficult tasks that require mature, expert-level coding skills in the technologies outlined, as the business requirements will be complex. 
 PREFERRED SKILLS: 
 Java
 J2EE
 Spring
 SQL
 Eclipse
 JSP
 Unix
 ClearCase
 WebSphere
 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6 to 12 MONTHS 
 
 INTERVIEW: PHONE & SKYPE
